question: In the Union Budget 2023-24, the Government of India has adopted Seven Priorities, which are termed as _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saptarishi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Saptarishi:-**

 
 
• **It refers to the seven priorities that the Government of India has adopted in the Union Budget 2023-24.**
 
• These priorities are aimed at promoting economic growth, social development, and environmental sustainability.
